part2.question: A person who works in a successful company

segments.v: I want to talk about my father. He is a civil engineer and he works for a big construction company in the north of Vietnam. He has worked there for almost twenty years. The company builds bridges, roads and metro stations. It has thousands of workers. My dad is a project manager. He checks designs and makes sure the building work is safe. His job is very busy. He often goes to work very early and comes home late. I think the company is successful because it always finishes projects on time and the quality is good. It also uses new technology. The workers are also very experienced and they stay with the company for a long time.
